name: kiro-hooks-init
description: Auto-detect and initialize Kiro hooks from a configurable template directory when opening a workspace

kiroHooksInit.templateDir.description: Absolute path to a directory containing hook template files. These will be copied to .kiro/hooks/ in new workspaces.

kiroHooksInit.fileExtensions.description: File extensions to sync from the template directory to .kiro/hooks/. Files matching any of these suffixes will be copied.

enumDescriptions: Only add missing and update outdated hooks. Never deletes anything (default).

Keep synced hooks matching the template: managed files removed from the template are deleted from the workspace. Manually added hooks are preserved via a manifest. The first sync asks for confirmation before deleting anything.
kiroHooksInit.syncMode.description: How the template directory is synced into .kiro/hooks/.
